sources.title: pidakwo/rtc-ner · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Description rtc-ner is a transformer-based spaCy NER model trained for the identification of domain-specific entities occurring in road traffic crash narratives. The model focuses particularly on extracting geographic locations and selected incident-related entities that are relevant to the analysis and geospatial structuring of RTC reports.
